Art History

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Art History at Radboud studies artworks, architecture and visual culture in their historical contexts, from antiquity to the present. It combines visual analysis, art-historical theories and methods, museum visits and independent research.

A complete UCR comparison is withheld while Radboud’s current curriculum needs clarification. The same Paris course appears in two years, leaving 10 EC without a verified distinct allocation. Art history, heritage and visual-media connections at UCR remain promising, but they are not approved programmes here.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary programme: supported components only

The degree is 180 EC. This list accounts for 170 distinct EC because the same 10-EC Paris course appears in both year 2 and year 3. The remaining 10 EC need clarification. Future Florence and Kunstwerelden courses are not treated as current replacements. This is a partial list, not a complete degree pathway. Required first-year mentoring, the Dutch academic-language diagnostic and second-year personal/professional development add no credits. Attendance applies to mentoring and seminars.

Restricted choice: two permitted 15-EC Faculty of Arts minors, one per semester, not a universal set of six named electives.


American Art: Colonial Times to Present
5 EC
One permitted 5 EC choice, selected from four alternatives and not previously counted in year 2. Other choices include Latin American art, classical reception and Low Countries art.


Van studie naar loopbaan: jouw vooruitzichten met (Kunst)Geschiedenis
5 EC
Required 5 EC career and personal/professional development course. The current programme does not require the future Kunstwerelden course here.


Bachelorwerkstuk + voorbereidende werkgroep
10 EC
Required 10 EC independent art-history research with preparatory meetings, written agreement, supervisor and second reader. The current OER permits entry after Florence or Paris; the catalogue still states both.


Vrije ruimte
30 EC
30 EC bachelor-level broadening outside the student’s own programme. Optional internship/exchange must meet applicable approval and overlap rules.
